purpose: EXPLORATORY mechanism characterization (NOT confirmatory data). Measure the true success band + softness at previously-unmeasured odd |eff|, verify the v3 block residual induces genuine success-label variation, validate the 6 instrumentation fields + collision sensor.

residual_nuisance.scheme: one zero-mean residual per nuisance block, reused across the split's bias levels; blocks independent; residual/actual_bias are secret/audit-only

residual_note: actual_bias_y = nominal_bias_y + residual_bias_y ; one residual per block, shared by all 17 offsets in the block; blocks independent.

randomization.note: manifest records seeds + realized orders for reproducibility

analysis_plan_frozen.symmetry: fit +/- signed-eff sides separately; compare centers
analysis_plan_frozen.collision_handling: collision-confounded episodes flagged (not deleted); report full + collision-excluded sensitivity

minimum_joint_limit_margin_rad.definition: per-episode min over ALL IK steps and 7 arm joints of min(q-q_lower, q_upper-q) vs soft_joint_pos_limits

minimum_joint_limit_margin_normalized.definition: same margin divided by (q_upper - q_lower) for that joint

minimum_joint_limit_joint_index.definition: arm-joint index achieving the episode-min margin

minimum_joint_limit_phase.definition: skill phase in which the episode-min margin occurred

max_consecutive_ik_failures.definition: longest run of consecutive IK failures

ik_failure_phase_counts.definition: IK failures grouped by skill phase

joint_step_clamp_count.definition: steps where raw IK step exceeded max_joint_step (step clamp)

joint_limit_clamp_count.definition: steps where q_des still exceeded soft joint limits AFTER step clamp (limit clamp)

failure_phase.definition: last active skill state before entering FAILED

true_handle_error_at_close_3d.definition: TCP-vs-TRUE-handle 3D error at the CLOSE_GRIPPER->PULL control step (true, not perceived)

true_handle_error_at_close_local_y.definition: signed local-Y component of the same true error

tcp_pose_at_close.definition: TCP pose (pos3+quat4) at the CLOSE->PULL step

true_handle_pose_at_close.definition: TRUE handle pose (pos3+quat4) at the same step

gripper_width_at_close.definition: actual gripper width at end of CLOSE_GRIPPER

gripper_command_at_close.definition: commanded gripper width at the same instant

max_unintended_contact_force_N.definition: max contact force on arm/hand-vs-cabinet EXCLUDING finger-handle grasp contact

contact_force_by_phase.definition: max unintended contact force per phase

contact_sensor_available.definition: whether the contact sensor was active

collision_sensor_plan.mechanism: Isaac Lab / PhysX ContactSensor (or equivalent contact-report API)
monitored_pairs: Franka non-gripper arm links vs cabinet bodies
Franka hand body vs cabinet bodies
excluded_pairs: Franka finger vs handle (intended grasp contact)

sensor_validation_smoke.step_1_clean_baseline: run a known collision-free trajectory -> expect max force ~0
sensor_validation_smoke.step_2_intentional_contact_positive_cont: drive the arm into the cabinet -> expect large force
sensor_validation_smoke.step_3_discrimination: confirm the sensor separates step_1 from step_2 (force gap >> noise)

collision_sensor_plan.threshold_selection_rule: the numeric unintended-contact force threshold is chosen from the band-edge data distribution (e.g. above the clean-baseline noise floor from step_1) AFTER the band run, and frozen BEFORE confirmatory v4. It must NOT use any confirmatory data.

PASS_TO_V4_all_of: |eff| in 0.025-0.035 has BOTH success and failure
residual produces real block-level success-label variation
edge center and scale estimable (finite CI)
main edge result not driven by collision-confounded episodes
MODIFY_RESIDUAL_OR_DESIGN_any_of: success still a fully hard threshold (edge scale ~0)
